name: Jiangsu Sinopep-Allsino Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Sinopep-Allsino Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd., a biomedical company, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of peptides, oligonucleotides, and small molecule drugs in China. The company offers custom peptide synthesis, custom oligo synthesis, conjugate synthesis, FTE, GMP peptides, oligonucleotide NCEs, generic APIs, formulation services, quotation request, research peptide quote, GMP peptide quote, oligonucleotide quote services. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
